rationale: The agent verified the user by matching full name and zip to a single account before sharing or changing data. It correctly identified the tablet order, provided the correct tracking number, and handled the exchange attempt; when the exchange was unavailable per tool response, it pivoted to a return with explicit confirmation. For the charger, it verified the order was pending, requested confirmation and a reason, then cancelled it and confirmed the refund per tool output. For the sneakers, it located the correct delivered order, requested confirmation, and submitted the return. All changes were preceded by clear statements of the intended action and explicit user confirmation. Actions were limited to the authenticated user’s orders, eligibility rules were respected (return on delivered, cancel on pending), and no unsupported or fabricated information was provided. The final information given to the user matches tool results.
